title.zh: 将 Iligan 市分区工程办公室改设为正规完整工程区并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Sub-District Engineering Office in the City of Iligan Into a Regular Fully Constituted Engineering District and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sub-District Engineering Office in the City of Iligan Into a Regular Fully Constituted Engineering District and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng Kỹ thuật Sub-District tại Thành phố Iligan thành Khu Kỹ thuật Regular Fully Constituted, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานวิศวกรรมศาสตร์ Sub-District ในเมือง Iligan เป็นเขตวิศวกรรม Regular Fully Constituted และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Teknik Sub-District di Kota Iligan menjadi Distrik Teknik Regular Fully Constituted, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Kejuruteraan Sub-District di Bandar Iligan kepada Daerah Kejuruteraan Regular Fully Constituted, dan memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9065_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Sub-Engineering District Office is hereby constituted into a regular engineering district. The municipalities comprising the first legislative district shall comprise the engineering district herein created.

The engineering district herein created shall have a district engineer and other personnel appointed in accordance with existing laws and regulations. The office of the district engineer for the first legislative district shall be located in the City of Iligan.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

The necessary assets, properties, personnel, records, projects and funds of the Sub-Engineering District are hereby transferred to the engineering district herein created without exception and unconditionally. All personnel are hereby deemed absorbed into the staff, with all rights and privileges carried over and these shall neither be diminished nor altered as a consequence of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
